title: Whispering
paragraphs: “I’ve heard all about your request for support. Very well, I shall arrange financial aid for your activities, provide you with weapons and armor, deploy the knight order during the waves, and even assist in hiring private soldiers for you.”
“Private soldiers…?”
“I believe he means party members.”
“I see. However, party members, huh…”

Father seemed to be gazing into the distance slightly. The same went for Ren and Itsuki. Well, it’s understandable—party members arranged by the country couldn’t be trusted. There was a very high chance that they were under the kingdom’s influence.
“We’ll find our own party members. Instead, focus on strengthening our support, such as class upgrades.”

“Is that so? Very well, I shall give those instructions. Once you have saved the world, you shall be granted an eternal noble title, lands, wealth, and even women. I ask you to fight for the sake of this world.”
The way he was throwing his authority around so arrogantly… It wasn’t just my imagination. Then, someone who seemed to be a minister presented a new cheat sheet to the Pig King.
“The Four Holy Heroes will also be given various tasks to handle. Would that be acceptable? Appropriate compensation will be provided.”
This was essentially the equivalent of government-issued quests in a game. I couldn’t shake the feeling that there was some ulterior motive behind it, but it would still lead to financial gain.
“Well… If it’s something we can do in between the waves.”
“That’s right. Doing such tasks might make it easier for us to operate.”

Ren and Itsuki continued their discussion, but the real key to making things easier was getting on the Pig King’s good side. After all, if we were to get on his bad side, we could end up turning the entire world against us. Even Faubrey wouldn’t be foolish enough to make such a mistake… though it wasn’t entirely impossible. Well, if it came down to it, I could just wipe them all out and make them realize their place.
At that moment, Father’s hand was tightly grasped by Mole. He must have realized that there was something he needed to bring up. Father stepped forward and spoke.
“That concludes our discussion as the Four Holy Heroes. Now, for a slightly more… sensitive matter. I have some confidential information that I must discuss with King Faubrey.”
“Buhuhu… And what might that be?”

“I have heard that King Faubrey is particularly fond of a certain… item. I will only say that much for now. However, I understand that His Majesty is a busy man. I wouldn’t want to take up too much of your valuable time. If you are interested, I will share more details—what do you say?”
“Hmm… Speak.”
“Then, I will hand this matter over to the Spear Hero, who is well-versed in this particular field.”

And so, it became my turn to step forward. Apparently, they thought it would be more persuasive if I were the one to speak. Something about my appearance making it more convincing, or so they claimed.

Father nodded. He kept looking between Mole and Sakura-chan, as if confirming something. Mole seemed to have understood, as she nodded in response. In other words, first, we would make them pay for what they did to Sakura-chan.
“First, how much do you know about the circumstances in which we overturned Melromarc’s conspiracy?”

“Buhuhu, I have heard the general outline. The Four Holy Heroes noticed the conspiracy and crushed it. Spear Hero, I have also heard that you are terrifyingly strong, even among past heroes. And? Is there something more to it?”
“Indeed. It may be hard to believe, but I have experienced the future of this world multiple times. I… have come from a future where we lost to the Waves, using the power of the Legendary Spear.”
King Faubrey tilted his head at my words. Well, that was to be expected.
“I can understand what you are saying to some extent. Then, tell me something about the future.”
Father had already given me various instructions on how to gain trust here. However, before I could get to the core of the matter, I needed to take things step by step.
“Indeed… First of all, King Faubrey, you were quite fixated on taking Melromarc’s Crimson Swine—”
What was the Crimson Swine’s real name again? Hmm… I couldn’t recall.
“It’s First Princess Malty.”
Itsuki whispered the answer to me. Ah, yes. That was the name of that pig.
“—as your concubine.”

“Buhuhu… You know quite a lot. But that is something anyone could find out with some investigation. Besides, I have also heard that the princess of Melromarc whom I wished to take as my bride was killed by the Heroes. What do you mean by that?”
“In the future, King Faubrey, Father—the Shield Hero—entrusted me with presenting her to you. However—”
I briefly explained what happened after the Crimson Swine was taken to the Pig King. If I remembered correctly, one of Takt’s allies had created a homunculus to serve as a decoy.
“In other words, I would end up embracing a fake?”
Even the Pig King seemed a bit displeased by that revelation.
“There are those in this country secretly conducting homunculus research.”
“Hmm… And? Do you expect me to believe this based on a mere hypothetical?”
“Of course not… This trivial information is merely the introduction.”
Yes, Father had told me to start with words that would pique King Faubrey’s interest. The real discussion was still ahead.
“The main topic begins now.”
“Indeed. I am sure it will be something that satisfies Your Majesty.”

Father backed me up. Yes, to gain trust, evidence speaks louder than words. It was the same method Father had personally taught me to earn Ren and Itsuki’s trust. Before that, I stepped closer to the Pig King. Immediately, his attendants moved forward in alarm.
“Do not come any closer! Even if you are one of the Four Holy Heroes, you are not permitted to approach the king!”
“If this information leaks, it will all be ruined, you know? I won’t share any of the fascinating details from the future unless it’s in a private conversation.”
I spoke to the Pig King in a deliberately provocative tone.
“King Faubrey, if you don’t listen to my words, you will regret it. Are you sure about that?”
“Buhuhu… You said the previous conversation was just an introduction. Very well… what do you have to say?”
Father’s brow twitched for an instant. Behind me, as I was explaining, I could hear a quiet exchange.
“They’ve already figured it out…”
“Huh? Really?”
“…Well, he is a king, after all?”
“At this point, the rest is just theatrics. Let’s leave it to Motoyasu-kun.”
I wasn’t entirely sure what they meant, but I continued.
“Let’s see… According to the previous… Shield Hero, King Faubrey will be able to obtain an enormous quantity of what he desires most.”
A loud gulp echoed from the Pig King. Father and the others looked slightly disgusted.

Among the people surrounding the Pig King, there were likely followers of Takt’s faction mixed in. They were on high alert. But I was well aware of the Pig King’s nature. Using the negotiation techniques personally taught by Father, I stepped forward.

“However, it seems that those around you do not wish for that to happen, Your Majesty. Since this wonderful offer is unwelcome, I suppose I will switch to a different plan… one that would result in a loss for you instead.”
At those words, the Pig King responded as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
“Buhuhuhu… Very well.”
“Your Majesty!”
“What are you so wary of when all I ask for is a simple whisper? Or do you dare oppose my decision?”
At that, the minister visibly flinched. As expected of the Pig King, a model tyrant. No doubt he had used similar intimidation tactics countless times before.
“Then, just in case, I shall cast a spell to expose any hidden individuals. If anyone is lurking in the shadows, you have mere moments before you die.”
My words heightened the tension even further, but the king’s personal guard stepped out from behind him. It must have been because the king himself raised his hand to command them.
“Liberation Fire Flasher!”

As I chanted the spell, pillars of fire erupted around me. As expected, there were hidden individuals. By the way, I frequently used this spell whenever I had to discuss things that I didn’t want others overhearing. Like when I told Father detailed information about the future.
“Oh… It seems there were those not under my direct command present.”
“Y-Yes… It appears they were quite skilled, but they fell before the Hero’s magic.”
“Buhuhu… You all suspected as much?”
“We sensed their presence. We had also located some of them… and were in the middle of investigating which faction they belonged to.”
Hearing the response from his guard, the Pig King nodded in approval.
